industry.headline: Families of four teens who died by suicide sue Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube
industry.summary: A new Delaware suit alleges platforms' addictive design caused four teens' deaths by suicide, part of an escalating litigation wave that includes a Meta trial in Tennessee this week and a federal states' trial in Oakland in August. Reinforces the regulatory/legal tailwind behind NOMO's off-social-media rewards model right as US GTM is active — strengthens the pitch to schools, parents and brand partners for an alternative to engagement-at-any-cost platforms.

industry.headline: Australia's under-16 social media ban failing, eSafety study shows
industry.summary: Three months after Australia's under-16 ban took effect, eSafety data shows over 80% of underage teens still using social media and daily use down only marginally (60% to 58%), with weak platform enforcement blamed. AU is exploratory-only for NOMO, but the result is a strong data point for NOMO's UK/US policy conversations: hard bans aren't moving usage, strengthening the case for incentive-driven behavioral tools as a complement or alternative.

reconsider.name: Flipd
